cases.prompt: An urgent customer feature enters an existing release while a technical spike and hardware dependency are unresolved.
required_behaviors: recognizes scope, capacity, dependency, evidence and release-control pressures
distinguishes process mismatch from technical uncertainty
forbidden_behaviors: prescribes Scrum ceremonies as the solution
baseline_expected_failure: agent creates a new sprint without commitment analysis
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Rebuild a product release flow from specifications, commits, tags, installer changes, tests and field fixes.
required_behaviors: separates planned, implemented, verified, released and deployed states
maps field feedback into controlled next-cycle work
forbidden_behaviors: treats document version as release truth
baseline_expected_failure: agent produces a chronology without governance or gates
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Review a HID read function for buffer overflow and lifetime defects.
required_behaviors: does not substitute a process recommendation for technical findings
forbidden_behaviors: suggests a ceremony instead of inspecting code
baseline_expected_failure: agent treats every defect as a process problem
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: One roadmap is organized by UI, recipe, manual run and auto run capabilities; another by shared libraries, process split, simulation and real hardware. Reconcile delivery governance.
required_behaviors: keeps capability and migration/deployment roadmaps distinct but linked
defines dependency, staffing, hardware, checkpoint and release-gate ownership
turns demos into explicit evidence and limitations
forbidden_behaviors: merges both roadmaps into dates without entry/exit criteria
treats a demo milestone as production readiness
baseline_expected_failure: agent produces a Gantt chart without architecture evidence
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, authority, lifecycle, failure behavior, and evidence; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Write a change-record entry's status field for a requirement that has been accepted and implemented but not yet verified or released.
required_behaviors: keeps requirement/implementation/verification/release status as separate dimensions, per document-governance's status model
leaves verification and release status distinct from implementation status rather than inferring them
forbidden_behaviors: writes a single flat 'Status: implemented' (or similar one-field) value that hides unverified/unreleased state
restates document-governance's status model instead of citing it
baseline_expected_failure: agent writes one flat Status field mixing requirement/implementation/verification/release into a single enumerated value, hiding that the change is unverified and unreleased
cases.review_notes: Distilled 2026-08-23: this Skill's own change-record template previously collapsed document-governance's explicit five-dimension status model (Section 6, 'a single done field hides important risk') into one flat Status field -- the exact anti-pattern that section names. Fixed in the same PR to cite document-governance instead of restating a flattened version. Companion case DOC-BEH-013 covers the document-governance side.
